lines: With Yaguruma Yaemon and Yao Bikuni's aid, Tokiko had narrowly escaped her predicament.
The remaining Igawa Ninja Forces in the grove had also been repelled by their subordinates for the time being.
The Fuma shinobi, who had become separated in the melee, were gradually coming back together.
Though there were only a small number of them left under Tokiko's command, the Fuma troops were on the verge of making a comeback.
Everyone, you've all done well to stay alive.
Tokiko began speaking in a quiet tone to those who had managed to gather together.
Their numbers were down to less than half, and they were covered in wounds from head to toe from the night's long battle.
However, not a single one of them had fled or cowered before their enemy.
The master is safe. This is where the Fuma now face their greatest trial.
We hath devised a most brilliant plan to aid thee.
Yaguruma Yaemon and Yao Bikuni had stepped forward in almost pre-determined unison.
Those Igawa vagabonds who attacked Fuma Village are a tremendous force.
It's vexing, I know, but we're still at a disadvantage.
Thusly, Yaemon and I shalt act as diversions to draweth the enemy's focus.
During this time, thou shouldst spirit the young lord and Gaiza-sama to safety.
But of course he is. So long as Yaemon is here, not a single soul shall lay a finger upon Gaiza-sa...ma... Hm? Come to think of it, I have not spied him for some time now?
Fufufu... 'tis late already. Gaiza-sama hath been over yonder for a time now.
On the ground where Bikuni had pointed, young Nisha Gaiza, heir to the Nisha Clan, lay there adrift in peaceful sleep.
Just as Tokiko had rescued Kotaro, they had also rescued Gaiza.
GUHUHUHUHUH!! He has some spunk to be dozing off at a time such as this. That's our Gaiza-sama for you!
Gaiza-sama, the young lord calls for you. Rise! Awaken!!
Gaiza stirred restlessly at Yaemon's calling.
Gaiza looked around the vicinity, his eyes darting here and there, and the moment he comprehended the situation he began to wail uncontrollably.
Kotaro quickly rushed to Gaiza's side.
Y-, young lord? My father! My father is...! Uwahh, waaaaahhh!!
Gaiza hugged Kotaro and sobbed even harder.
But to the timid Gaiza, Kotaro was like an older brother.
Holding back his own sadness, Kotaro admirably consoled his crybaby little brother.
Gaiza, Tokiko will make sure we get to a safe place.
So don't cry. You're going to be a family head too. The head of the Nisha Clan.
Eh-hngh, eh-hnegh, young lord, I... unngh, won't cry!
I'll make sure... *hic* ...that I take revenge, f-for both our fathers, with you, young lord!
Gaiza had scrubbed away his tears at Kotaro's encouragement and made his proclamation.
Now then, Tokiko-sama, we entrust Gaiza-sama unto thee...
These were two of the most powerful figures in the clan.
Yet the enemy numbers were still far too great even for them.
Not to mention the fact that being a diversion meant they had to draw all of the enemy's attention directly to themselves.
No need to worry. We have no intention of expiring just yet.
Upon our success, we intend to rescue thy mother and flee.
Yaemon, Bikuni, make sure you come back.
It shall be as you wish!!
Pray, forgive our brief absence, Gaiza-sama.
Yaemon slipped underground into the earth, and Bikuni disappeared as if she had dissolved herself into the very darkness.
Then we'll be on our way, too.
Thus, Yaemon and Bikuni set out to create the diversion that would allow Kotaro and Gaiza to escape,
while Tokiko took the boys and led the few remaining troops to begin marching in the opposite direction.
A short time had passed, and Tokiko and the others were hiding out on a mountain path.
Once they ascended this mountain path and passed through the temple at the top, they would be outside of Fuma Village.
But there would undoubtedly be enemies waiting in ambush there.
If they continued on this path, it would be tantamount to marching into a death trap.
Yaemon and Bikuni, who had gone to town to create a diversion, were their only chance of survival.
As the bearers of the Fuma's future hopes, the two young children were doing their best to support and encourage each other.
It was better than being alone after all.
The sight of this had given Tokiko new hope and lifted her spirits significantly.
One of her subordinates came running up to her.
A new fire started in town!
A thin smile spread across Tokiko's face.
Although they had decided on a start time for the diversion, they had no idea how difficult it would be to proceed accordingly once they were amid the enemy forces.
It was the first time something seemed possible to pull off that night thanks to the two powerhouses of the Nisha.
We head for the summit without delay!
Leave the fallen and those who cannot follow.
Despite the coldness of her words, not a single voice of objection arose to counter her.
Tokiko, Kotaro, Gaiza, and the few remaining Fuma Ninja Forces rushed up the mountain path in unison.
With a swiftness like the wind, Tokiko and the others reached a point near the summit.
Perhaps luck was on their side, because they hadn't encountered any enemies up to this point.
Near the temple that marked the summit of the mountain, Igawa shinobi had been waiting in ambush.
But their defensive line was indeed thinner than expected.
It was proof that Yaemon and Bikuni's diversion was bearing fruit.
Even so, given Tokiko's fighting force they were still quite heavily outnumbered.
Normally, this would be the time to withdraw or consider other measures.
But in this moment, Tokiko's resolution did not waver.
